title: Adiectīva Classis Prīmae
subtitle: Adiectīva in -ος/-η/-ον (ut καλός) et -ος/-α/-ον (ut μικρός post ε/ι/ρ); concordantia cum nōmine in genere, numerō, cāsū.
objectives: Dēclīnāre plēnē adiectīvum classis prīmae (ut καλός) per omnia tria genera, omnēs cāsūs, utrōque numerō
Distinguere fēminīnum in -η (post cōnsonantem commūnem) ā fēminīnō in -α (post ε, ι, ρ)
Applicāre rēgulam concordantiae: adiectīvum semper concordat cum nōmine suō in genere/numerō/cāsū, etiam sī dēclīnātiōnēs eōrum differunt
Distinguere positiōnem attribūtīvam (cum articulō repetītō vel adiectīvō intrā articulum-nōmen) ā positiōne praedicātīvā

content.intro: Adiectīva classis prīmae (dicta etiam “adiectīva -ος/-η/-ον”) sunt classis maxima et frequentissima adiectīvōrum Graecōrum. Masculīnum et neutrum sequuntur exāctē dēclīnātiōnem secundam (Gradū II iam nōtam), fēminīnum sequitur dēclīnātiōnem prīmam — sed cum sōlum duābus, nōn tribus, variantibus (ā lēctiōne Dēclīnātiō Prīma memor esto rēgulam simpliciōrem hīc applicandam).
content.explanation: Adiectīvum Graecum, sīcut Latīnum, concordat cum nōmine suō in genere, numerō, et cāsū — sed NŌN necesse est dēclīnātiōnem eandem sequī: nōmen potest esse tertiae dēclīnātiōnis (quam in Gradū III vidēbis) et adiectīvum eius manet classis prīmae, sī tantum genus/numerus/cāsus concordant. Fēminīnum adiectīvōrum classis prīmae sequitur rēgulam simpliciōrem quam nōmina: SI thema (stem) fīnītur ε, ι, vel ρ, fēminīnum est in -α per tōtam dēclīnātiōnem (nūlla mūtātiō in η, umquam); ALITER, fēminīnum est in -η per tōtam dēclīnātiōnem. Nūllum adiectīvum monstrat patrōnum “impūrum mixtum” (α in nōm./acc., η in gen./dat.) quem nōmina ut δόξα monstrant — ista mixtūra est phaenomenon proprium tantum nōminum, nōn adiectīvōrum.

rules.heading: a) Adiectīvum in -η: Paradigma καλός, καλή, καλόν (pulcher)
rules.body:
CāsusMasc. sg.Fem. sg.Neut. sg.
Nōm.καλόςκαλήκαλόν
Gen.καλοῦκαλῆςκαλοῦ
Dat.καλῷκαλῇκαλῷ
Acc.καλόνκαλήνκαλόν

Plūrālis: masc. καλοί, καλῶν, καλοῖς, καλούς — fem. καλαί, καλῶν, καλαῖς, καλάς — neut. καλά, καλῶν, καλοῖς, καλά. Thema καλ- fīnītur λ (nōn ε/ι/ρ), ergō fēminīnum est -η.

rules.heading: b) Adiectīvum in -α (post ε/ι/ρ): Paradigma μικρός, μικρά, μικρόν (parvus)
rules.body: Thema μικρ- fīnītur ρ, ergō fēminīnum sequitur patrōnum “pūrum”: μικρά, μικρᾶς, μικρᾷ, μικράν (sg.), μικραί, μικρῶν, μικραῖς, μικράς (pl.) — α longum per tōtam dēclīnātiōnem, numquam mūtātum in η. Masculīnum/neutrum manent identica patrōnō λόγος/δῶρον: μικρός, μικροῦ, μικρῷ, μικρόν. Alia exempla huius classis: νέος, νέα, νέον (novus, iuvenis — thema fīnītur ε).

rules.heading: c) Concordantia et Positiō
rules.body: Adiectīvum concordat cum nōmine in genere/numerō/cāsū, indepēndenter ā dēclīnātiōne ipsīus nōminis: ὁ καλὸς ἀνήρ (vir pulcher — ἀνήρ est tertiae dēclīnātiōnis, sed adiectīvum manet classis prīmae, concordāns sōlum in genere/numerō/cāsū). Positiō attribūtīva (adiectīvum intrā articulum et nōmen, vel articulus repetītus post nōmen): ὁ καλὸς λόγος vel ὁ λόγος ὁ καλός = “verbum pulchrum [istud]”. Positiō praedicātīva (adiectīvum EXTRĀ hanc structūram, articulus nōn repetītus): ὁ λόγος καλός [ἐστιν] = “verbum est pulchrum”. Discrīmen positiōnis mūtat sēnsum fundāmentāliter, nōn sōlum stylum.

examples: ὁ καλὸς λόγος. — Illud pulchrum verbum. (attribūtīvum: adiectīvum intrā articulum-nōmen)
ὁ λόγος καλός [ἐστιν]. — Verbum [est] pulchrum. (praedicātīvum: iūdicium, nōn descrīptiō)
ἡ μικρὰ οἰκία. — Domus parva. (fēminīnum -α, post ρ)
τὸ καλὸν δῶρον. — Dōnum pulchrum. (neutrum, concordāns cum δῶρον)
τῶν καλῶν γυναικῶν. — Mulierum pulchrārum. (genetīvus plūrālis fēminīnus, concordāns cum nōmine tertiae dēclīnātiōnis)
οἱ μικροὶ παῖδες. — Puerī parvī. (masculīnum plūrāle, concordāns cum παῖδες tertiae dēclīnātiōnis)

commonMistakes.wrong: Crēdere adiectīvum debēre sequī eandem dēclīnātiōnem ac nōmen cui concordat.
commonMistakes.right: Recordārī adiectīvum concordat SŌLUM in genere/numerō/cāsū cum nōmine — dēclīnātiō (patrōnus dēsinentiārum) ipsīus adiectīvī manet indepēndēns.
commonMistakes.why: Error commūnis, praesertim postquam nōmina tertiae dēclīnātiōnis (Gradū III) intrōducuntur cum adiectīvīs classis prīmae.

commonMistakes.wrong: Applicāre rēgulam trium subclassium nōminum (η, α pūrum, α impūrum mixtum) ad fēminīnum adiectīvōrum.
commonMistakes.right: Recordārī adiectīva habent sōlum duās subclassēs (η, aut α pūrum post ε/ι/ρ) — nūllum patrōnum “mixtum” sīcut δόξα.
commonMistakes.why: Adiectīva sequuntur processum morphologicum magis regulārem/analogicum quam nōmina, quod ēliminat patrōnum mixtum.

commonMistakes.wrong: Nōn distinguere positiōnem attribūtīvam ā praedicātīvā, trānsferendō ambās identidem.
commonMistakes.right: Vidēre sī articulus repetītur/adiectīvum est intrā articulum-nōmen (attribūtīvum, “X quī est Y”) vel nōn (praedicātīvum, “X est Y”).
commonMistakes.why: Sēnsus fundāmentāliter mūtātur: ὁ καλὸς λόγος (descrīptiō) vs. ὁ λόγος καλός (iūdicium/affirmātiō).

items.prompt: Quae fōrma fēminīna sequitur adiectīvum μικρός (thema in ρ)?
items.explanation: Thema fīnītum ρ requīrit fēminīnum in -α pūrum, per tōtam dēclīnātiōnem.

items.prompt: Quid significat ὁ λόγος ὁ καλός (vel ὁ καλὸς λόγος)?
items.explanation: Adiectīvum intrā articulum-nōmen (vel articulus repetītus) est positiō attribūtīva.

items.prompt: Habent adiectīva classis prīmae patrōnum “mixtum” (α in nōm., η in gen./dat.), sīcut nōmen δόξα?
options: nōn, numquam — sōlum duae subclassēs exsistunt (η aut α pūrum)
items.explanation: Adiectīva habent sōlum duo patrōnōs fēminīnī, nōn tria sīcut nōmina.

options: cum genere, numerō, et cāsū nōminis
items.explanation: Concordantia est in genere/numerō/cāsū, indepēndenter ā dēclīnātiōne ipsā nōminis.

items.prompt: Quae fōrma est genetīvus singulāris masculīnus/neutrus adiectīvī καλός?
items.explanation: Genetīvus singulāris masc./neut. sequitur dēclīnātiōnem secundam: καλοῦ.

exercises.title: Complē Fōrmam Rēctam
exercises.instructions: Comple spatia cum fōrmā rēctā adiectīvī, concordantem cum nōmine datō.

items.prompt: καλός + γυνή (fem. sg. nōm.): ἡ γυνὴ ___
items.explanation: Fēminīnum singulāre nōminātīvum, thema in λ, requīrit -η: καλή.

items.prompt: μικρός + δῶρα (neut. pl. nōm.): τὰ δῶρα ___
items.explanation: Neutrum plūrāle nōminātīvum: -α (identicum masc./neut. patrōnō, applicātum hīc ad thema μικρ-).

items.prompt: καλός + λόγων (masc. gen. pl.): τῶν λόγων τῶν ___
μικρός + οἰκίας (fem. acc. sg.): τὴν οἰκίαν τὴν ___
items.explanation: Accūsātīvus singulāris fēminīnus, patrōnum pūrum: μικράν.

items.prompt: καλός + ἀνθρώποις (masc. dat. pl.): τοῖς ἀνθρώποις τοῖς ___

exercises.title: Vērum an Falsum
exercises.instructions: Dēcerne utrum vērum an falsum sit.

items.statement: Adiectīvum Graecum debet sequī eandem dēclīnātiōnem (patrōnum dēsinentiārum) ac nōmen cui concordat.
items.explanation: Falsum: concordat sōlum in genere/numerō/cāsū, nōn in patrōnō dēclīnātiōnis.

items.statement: Νέος, νέα, νέον sequitur patrōnum α pūrum in fēminīnō, quia thema fīnītur ε.
items.explanation: Corrēctum: thema νε- fīnītur ε, ergō fēminīnum est α pūrum per tōtam dēclīnātiōnem.

items.statement: Ὁ λόγος ὁ καλός et ὁ λόγος καλός significant exāctē idem.
items.explanation: Falsum: prīmum est attribūtīvum (“illud pulchrum verbum”), secundum praedicātīvum (“verbum [est] pulchrum”).

items.statement: Adiectīva classis prīmae possunt monstrāre patrōnum mixtum (α in nōm., η in gen./dat.).
items.explanation: Falsum: hoc patrōnum est proprium tantum nōminum (ut δόξα), numquam adiectīvōrum.

summary: Adiectīva classis prīmae: masc./neut. sequuntur dēclīnātiōnem secundam; fēminīnum sequitur prīmam, sed sōlum in duābus subclassibus (-η, aut -α pūrum post ε/ι/ρ).
Καλός, καλή, καλόν: masc./neut. -ος/-ον (ut λόγος/δῶρον); fem. -η (ut τιμή).
Μικρός, μικρά, μικρόν: fem. -α pūrum per tōtam dēclīnātiōnem (thema in ρ).
Adiectīvum concordat cum nōmine in genere/numerō/cāsū, indepēndenter ā dēclīnātiōne ipsīus nōminis.
Positiō attribūtīva (ὁ καλὸς λόγος) ≠ positiō praedicātīva (ὁ λόγος καλός) — discrīmen sēnsūs, nōn sōlum stylī.
